profile.headline: Senior Java Software Engineer | MSc in Computer Science
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience designing, developing, and delivering scalable, high-performance enterprise applications across banking, financial services, semiconductor, Big Data analytics, AI/LLMs, insurance, and manufacturing (MES). Expertise in Java, Python, Spring Boot, microservices, distributed systems, RESTful APIs, Kafka, Kubernetes, and enterprise integration. Experienced in designing secure, resilient, and maintainable backend systems, integrating Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) into enterprise applications, and optimizing application performance. Proven ability to deliver high-quality software using Agile/Scrum, DevOps, CI/CD, and modern software engineering best practices.…

Skills summary:

Programming Languages: Java, Python, Scala, C/C++
Backend & Microservices: Spring Boot, Spring Framework (Security, Cloud, Integration, AOP), Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, MyBatis, Java EE, Microservices Architecture, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, gRPC, SOAP, OpenAPI (Swagger), Spring Cloud Gateway, Spring Cloud OpenFeign, Resilience4j, Struts
Security: Spring Security, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JWT Authentication & Authorization
Frontend: React, Node.js (Express), JavaScript (ES6), HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, jQuery, JSP/Servlets.
Databases: Oracle, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB, Presto, SQLite, H2, HSQLDB
Caching & In-Memory Data Grid: Redis, Hazelcast
Messaging & Event Streaming: Apache Kafka, ActiveMQ, JMS
Big Data & Search: Apache Spark, Hadoop, Hive, HBase, Avro, Pig, Sqoop, Flume, Elasticsearch (ELK)
Cloud & Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, AWS (Amazon S3)
CI/CD, Build & Code Quality: Maven, Gradle, Git, Jenkins, SonarQube
Testing & API Tools: JUnit 5, Mockito, Postman
Monitoring & Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)
Workflow Orchestration: Apache Airflow
Application Servers: Apache Tomcat, JBoss, IBM WebSphere, Oracle Application Server (OAS) 10g
Design Patterns: MVC, Singleton, Factory, Abstract Factory, Builder, Prototype, Adapter…
Development Tools: IntelliJ IDEA, Eclipse, PyCharm, Visual Studio, JDeveloper
Operating Systems: Linux, Windows, macOS
Methodologies: Agile (Scrum, Kanban), Waterfall, Rational Unified Process (RUP)
Artificial Intelligence: Machine Learning, Deep Learning (TensorFlow), Generative AI/LLMs, Gemini

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, developed and delivered secure, scalable microservices and distributed applications for Citi's digital banking platform, supporting customer onboarding, regulatory compliance, and enterprise services.
 
- Developed mission-critical microservices for customer onboarding (subaccounts), approvals, KYC Data migration, TIN certification, and Digital Assistant services.
- Automated CI/CD pipelines and implemented DevOps best practices to improve software delivery and deployment efficiency.
- Optimized application performance, scalability, reliability, and testing processes for high-volume enterprise applications.
- Conducted code reviews and enforced engineering best practices to improve software quality and reduce technical debt.
- Developed Generative AI solutions using Gemini LLM to enhance enterprise applications and business workflows.
 
Environment: Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, gRPC, Oracle, MongoDB, Kafka, Hazelcast, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Jenkins, Tekton, Harness, Elasticsearch (ELK), SonarQube, OpenAPI (Swagger), Airflow, Python, Gemini (LLM), Maven, GitHub, Bitbucket, Postman, Jira
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Microservices · REST APIs · MongoDB · Apache Kafka · Hazelcast · OpenShift · Jenkins · ElasticSearch · Apache Airflow · Bitbucket · Python · Redis · Google Gemini · Large Language Models (LLM) · Maven · Tekton CI/CD · Docker · Kubernetes · Sonarqube · Open API · Oracle Database

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and enhanced the Real Estate and Loan Management (REAL) platform, delivering enterprise solutions for loan lifecycle management, trading, and valuation for Goldman Sachs investment bank

- Resolved production issues to improve application stability, data integrity, and system reliability.
- Enhanced data upload and Due Diligence reporting capabilities to support evolving business requirements.
- Designed and developed contract and agreement management features for the repurchasing module.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions for enterprise loan management.
 
Environment: Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, MongoDB, React, Maven, Elasticsearch (ELK), OpenAPI (Swagger), Oracle
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Microservices · REST APIs · MongoDB · React.js · Maven · ElasticSearch · Open API · Oracle Database · Elastic Stack (ELK) · Swagger API

positions.title: Principal Research Engineer
positions.description:
Developed scalable backend microservices and AI-driven solutions for an enterprise analytics platform serving a leading semiconductor manufacturer.
 
- Designed and developed backend microservices, RESTful APIs, and middleware for enterprise and legacy system integration.
- Delivered new platform features and client-specific customizations to meet evolving business requirements.
- Resolved critical production issues to improve application performance, reliability, and data accuracy.
- Deployed and supported enterprise software solutions at customer sites.
- Developed a TensorFlow-based deep learning solution for automated defect classification, replacing the legacy Rainforest algorithm.
 
Environment: Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, MyBatis, Maven, Python, TensorFlow, Kafka, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, Elasticsearch (ELK), Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite, Presto, Jenkins, GitLab, JWT, OpenCV, SciPy, Jira.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Microservices · REST APIs · Maven · Python · TensorFlow · Apache Kafka · Redis · Docker · Kubernetes · Elastic Stack (ELK) · ElasticSearch · Oracle Database · Microsoft SQL Server · PrestoDB · Jenkins · Jira · Big Data · Machine Learning · MyBatis · PostgreSQL · SQLite · Gitlab · JSON Web Token (JWT) · OpenCV · SciPy · Analytic Platform

positions.title: Senior Application Architect
positions.description:
Modernized an enterprise insurance policy administration platform through legacy transformation, solution architecture, and enterprise integrations.

- Led the migration of the insurance platform from COBOL (SMART/400) to Java while preserving business functionality.
- Designed technical solutions and implementation strategies in collaboration with customers, stakeholders, and pre-sales teams.
- Led product enhancements, client customizations, and enterprise system integrations.
- Architected and developed core platform components and integration services to improve scalability and maintainability.
- Provided technical leadership through architecture reviews, design guidance, and software engineering best practices.
 
Environment: Java, JSP/Servlet, Maven, Jenkins, Eclipse, Tomcat, WebSphere, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, SMART/400, Jira
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Java Enterprise Edition · Maven · Jenkins · Oracle Database · Microsoft SQL Server · Tomcat · WebSphere · SMART/400 · Insurance

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and middleware applications to support manufacturing operations and enterprise system integration

- Developed MES modules for order, production, shipping, and sales management.
- Designed and implemented middleware applications for device communication and data integration with MES
- Built enterprise applications using Java EE, Oracle technologies, and messaging frameworks

Environment: Java, Java EE (JSP, Servlets, EJB, JMS), Oracle Database, Oracle ADF, MVC, Eclipse RCP, Tomcat, WebLogic, Oracle Application Server (OAS) 10g, COM/DCOM, JDeveloper

positions.title: Project Development Manager
positions.description:
Led the development of a real-time Forex trading dashboard, delivering market data visualization and automated trading solutions

- Managed project planning, technical execution, and cross-functional development teams throughout the project lifecycle.
- Designed and developed core application modules for real-time market data processing, transformation, and visualization using the FIX protocol.
- Integrated automated trading strategies into the trading platform to support real-time decision-making.
- Collaborated with stakeholders to deliver scalable, high-performance trading solutions that met business objectives

Environment: Java, MySQL, FIX Protocol, Macromedia Flash, Dreamweaver, JBuilder
